name: Candice Rasa
abstract_title: Akashic Records and Mental Health Outcomes: A Mixed-Methods Study of a Nonlocal, Experiential Intervention
abstract: In recent years, interest in nonlocal and transpersonal healing modalities in comparison to conventional mental health care has increased among populations seeking emotional support, spiritual insight, and deeper pattern understanding of karmic and ancestral relevance. Drawing on frameworks from energy psychology and nonlocal consciousness (e.g., Laszlo’s Akashic Field Theory, Rubik’s biofield hypothesis, Sheldrake’s morphic resonance, and Siegel’s “plane of possibility”), this study investigate
